description: For one product, list every shop selling the same item (matched by barcode or brand + part number), cheapest total price first, with each shop's delivery promise. Answers "where is this cheapest" and "who delivers it tomorrow". Pass product_key or offer_id.

max_delivery_days.description: Only shops that promise delivery within this many working days (1 = tomorrow).

offer_id.description: Or an offer id (e.g. cheapestOfferId from search_products).

name: compare_prices
title: Compare prices across shops
